note: by_count: signed p10/p90 of log(V/P) of out-of-sample unit-months binned by PREDICTED count P (pooled cell/province/country), per satellite set; used for the country. by_region: the same bins per fire-regime region (cell+province residuals of the region; source=pooled where n<30); used for cells, provinces and user AOIs (region with the largest predicted count). 80% prediction interval = [P*exp(p10), P*exp(p90)]. by_level: reference quantiles. band_coverage: in-sample coverage of the pooled band. regional_band_test: coverage of pooled / regional / region×level bands measured out-of-sample for the band (leave-one-year-out on the residuals).
